verdicts.what_is_true_en: India's Chandrayaan-3 mission successfully landed near the Moon's south pole on August 23, 2023, making it the first country to achieve a landing in that region.
verdicts.reasoning_en: Multiple credible sources, including a TIER_1 source, NASA (ws-2), and TIER_3 source Space.com (ws-3), confirm that India's Chandrayaan-3 mission successfully landed near the Moon's south pole on August 23, 2023. These sources explicitly state that this made India the first country to achieve a landing in this specific lunar region. There is no credible evidence contradicting this fact. Several fact-checking articles are provided, but they debunk unrelated fake videos and images, not the landing event itself.

verdicts.label: TRUE
verdicts.what_is_true_en: The Vikram lander of the Chandrayaan-3 mission successfully touched down on the Moon on August 23, 2023, at 18:04 local time (12:34 GMT).
verdicts.reasoning_en: Multiple news outlets confirm the specific time of the Chandrayaan-3 landing. BBC News (ws-5) and NDTV (ws-6) both report that the Vikram lander touched down at 18:04 local time on August 23, 2023. BBC News specifies this corresponds to 12:34 GMT. Other sources like Space.com (ws-7) and Al Jazeera (ws-8) reported the same scheduled time just before the landing occurred, adding to the consistency of the evidence. There is no evidence to contradict this specific time.
